description: **Core mechanic** : Sisay grows with legendary permanents and tutors any legend with {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
**Engine** : a toolbox of legends — answer anything with the right legend (Derevi, Selvala, Bloom Tender).
**Payoff** : the legendary value engine — ramp, draw, removal and threats on demand.
win: **Combo** : assemble a legendary combo (e.g. Jodah + big spells).

description: **Core mechanic** : historic spells (legendary, artifact, saga) trigger historic synergies.
**Engine** : Jhoira, Weatherlight Captain and historic payoff cards.
**Payoff** : cast legendary/historic spells to draw and storm.
win: **Historic storm** : chain historic spells into a big finish.

description: **Core mechanic** : the competitive shell — fast mana, tutors and compact combos.
**Engine** : Sisay's ability as a repeatable legend tutor for combo pieces.
**Payoff** : assemble a win fast through disruption.
win: **Combo** : compact legendary combos (e.g. Derevi + untap loops).
**Lock** : stax pieces that stop the table.

description: **Core mechanic** : Sisay finds the combo pieces — the deck is a tutor-dense combo machine.
**Engine** : legends that untap, draw or generate mana to chain into the win.
**Payoff** : assemble an infinite loop through Sisay's tutoring.
win: **Infinite combos** : legend-based loops (e.g. Derevi + untap, Jodah + omniscience-ish).

description: **Core mechanic** : superfriends — Sisay tutors planeswalkers and they ult fast.
**Engine** : Oath of Teferi and Teferi, Time Raveler chain walker activations.
win: **Walker ults** : Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God / Teferi ults.

combos.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures.
combos.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.

Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking the creature that creates creature tokens upon entering the battlefield.
When the creature enters, it triggers, creating at least two creature tokens.
Activate the creature and two tokens by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Repeat.

combos.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Birds of Paradise.
combos.description:

Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Birds of Paradise.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may repeat for infinite colored mana.

primer.plan_title: 🏛️ LEGENDS / TOOLBOX — The signature plan (1,419 decks)
primer.plan_html:
🏛️ LEGENDS / TOOLBOX CHOSEN PLAN

The dominant plan for Sisay (1,419 Legends decks, 1,093 Historic, 837 cEDH on EDHREC).

How it plays
  • Ramp first : 5-color dorks (Faeburrow Elder, Bloom Tender, Birds of Paradise) get Sisay out fast.
  • Repeatable toolbox : her {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} ability searches any legendary permanent with mana value less than her power and puts it onto the battlefield.
  • Scaling : more colors among your legends = bigger Sisay = bigger tutors.
Core loop
  • Multiple activations : untap engines (Derevi on attack, Ioreth, Minamo, Great Hall of the Citadel) let Sisay tutor several times per turn.
  • Right legend for the moment : removal (Boseiju), draw (Esper Sentinel), protection (Teferi), finishers (Jodah, Nicol Bolas).
Win conditions
  • Legend army : pumped by Jodah / Heroes' Podium / Flowering of the White Tree.
  • Post-wipe : Primevals' Glorious Rebirth.
  • Infinite mana : tutorable combos (Derevi + Emiel blink, Kinnan + untap aura) into a huge finale.
primer.source_html: “Hidden Gems: Sisay, Weatherlight Captain” (EDHREC Articles — deck tech on Sisay): the guide highlights Sisay’s unique role as a repeatable legendary tutor and stresses that the deck wins by having “the right legendary for the right situation” — a toolbox philosophy. It recommends stacking 5-color mana producers so Sisay can activate early and often, and pairing her with untap effects to chain multiple searches per turn. That maps directly onto our build: dorks (Faeburrow Elder, Bloom Tender, Selvala) power the engine, untappers (Derevi, Ioreth, Minamo) double it, and the legend pool covers every axis — ramp, draw, removal, protection and finishers.

Sisay herself tutors most of these pieces, making the combo lines genuinely accessible. Produces/Prerequisites/Execution reproduce Commander Spellbook content verbatim.
